overloadMerges.note: array and itemRefs are documented and arrow-marked ('←') as arrays filled by the command with the list's items/reference numbers, not inputs, even though the draft parser defaulted every parameter to direction:in based on syntax position alone.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills array (and optionally itemRefs) with the first-level items -- and their reference numbers -- of the hierarchical list or choice list designated by list.
